tests.name: R1 a stored payload is served byte-identical and its SHA-256 equals the index's; POST /ai/index.json is refused
R2 many requests with different headers write no row and every answer is byte-equal; a challenge does write
R3 a payload signed with a throwaway key in the list is stored and served; a changed byte, an undecided entry and an old seq are refused
R4 a lapse of a listed entry is stored; a retire of a listed entry is ADVISORY_BAD_MOVE
R5 after a payload (7) and two advisories (8, 9) the index names 7 and lists 8 and 9; after payload 10 they are gone
R6 list then hold leaves the entry undecided for publishing; a decision without a ruling is DECISION_NO_RULING
R7 a watch with the standing ref and canary_drift is stored; clear without its decision, other with only the standing ref, and a bogus reason are refused
R8 the seal-key document verifies container-side against the list; one signed by a key outside the list is not published
R9 a released digest answers a nonce recorded with its provider and plan; an unreleased digest is refused and no two nonces are equal
R10 the cap-plus-one request is refused and mints nothing; once expiries free the cap a request succeeds
R11 a registered digest passes the challenge, a withdrawn one fails; a malformed digest is refused
R12 a well-formed bundle from a throwaway run key answers verified_envelope; a reused nonce, an unissued nonce, a changed manifest character and an unknown digest do not
R13 each failure answers unverified or rejected and never verified_envelope; only a bundle passing every check does, with a token stored as its hash only
R14 a manifest with declared_team and no agree_named is stored without it; with agree_named the name is kept
R15 no export, binding or table of the Worker holds a private key; a planted private key in the environment is refused at start
R16 a scored bundle stores REPORTED, a canary run REPRODUCED, a re-score supersedes; unverified, REPRODUCED-for-a-receipt and a repeat are refused
R17 an unnamed bundle's row says only team; a named one carries its name; after withdrawName the next call omits it
R18 the sweep destroys a bundle of an unlisted AI tested seven months ago and keeps one of an AI lapsed eleven months ago; a listed AI tested two years ago is kept
R19 an act without the credential is refused with nothing done and appends only its refusal; with it the act is audited with by
R20 with the store failing, the index answers 200 and a challenge answers ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE; healthy, both succeed
R25 a token answers pending, then its scored result; another bundle's token never answers it and the request writes no row
R26 two reports for one entry and day sum into one row with reports 2 and no other row of either; a report whose refused exceeds its calls adds nothing
R21 the Worker's declared bindings name no account but Civicsmith's; a binding to another account fails the deploy check
R22 a nonce issued at a pinned instant expires at that instant plus its life; with no pin the wall clock is read
R23 each code is answered with its row and no English sentence; a code with no row fails
R24 a sentinel in every field of a request, bundle and manifest appears in no row except where R14 allows; with agree_named the name is the one stored sentinel
